reason: Primary abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) has become a key architecture for scaling large language models (LLMs), yet its dynamic routing causes severe load imbalance in expert-parallel training. Existing dynamic-replica methods copy hot experts onto idle ranks to share comput Expert replica placement targets MoE training.
title: TAOT: Topology-Aware Optimal Transport for Dynamic Expert Replica Placement in MoE Training
